Shooting works: 120 words became targets, and a test shot blew up "Firefox" and "model". Next I'm taking a screenshot to check how it looks.

ran trif run 'const k=(t,key)=>dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(t,{key})); k("keydown"," "); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); k("keyup"," "); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); return 1' && trif screenshot -o shooter.png

The page is now a space shooter. A small glowing ship sits at the bottom of the screen.

- **← →** fly the ship left and right.
- **Space** fires twin pink lasers. Hold it down for rapid fire.
- **Any word you hit** blows up. Its letters spin out in the word's own font and colour, fall, bounce off the bottom and fade. There's a small burst of sparks too.
- **R** brings all the words back. A small readout in the bottom-left corner counts the words you've blasted.

**What I checked:** The page loads without errors and all 120 words on it can be shot. In a test I flew to a word and fired: "Firefox" and "model" blew up and the counter went up. A screenshot shows the ship, the counter and letters flying. I put the test words back afterwards.

**Things to know:**
- Your neon title mod splits the big title into separate letters, so you shoot those one letter at a time.
- The arrow keys and space no longer scroll the page. They still work normally while you're typing in a text box.

I made the changes and tested them on the page.

- **Ship:** 3 times bigger. The two lasers now fire from its wingtips.
- **Lasers:** fat glowing pink bolts with a white-hot core. They're wider, so they also hit words that are only partly under them.
- **Hits:** each word now blows up much bigger:
  - a white flash and an orange shockwave ring that grows bigger for longer words
  - about 70 coloured sparks
  - the word's letters fly out much harder and swell to up to 3× their size as they tumble
- **Screen shake:** the whole page jolts with each hit and settles in about a third of a second. Several quick hits shake it harder, up to a set limit.

**What I checked:** I reloaded the page and fired a burst. Three words blew up, the page shook by a few pixels, and it settled back to normal afterwards. A screenshot shows the big ship, the fat bolts, the rings and the sparks. No errors came up, and I put the test words back.

To undo it, switch off **Space Shooter** in the side panel, or ask me to.
Now checking it together with your gravity mod.

With the shooter on, pressing G made everything fly up off the top of the screen instead of falling. Fixed. Gravity and the shooter now work together: pressing G makes the page fall and pile up at the bottom again, and the shooter keeps working on the fallen pile.

**The cause:** gravity mode takes every visible thing on the page and lets it fall. That included the shooter's transparent drawing layer, which covers the whole screen. That layer landed on the floor like a screen-sized block and pushed everything else up off the top.

**The fix:** I changed one line in your gravity mod. It now skips layers that are fixed in place and that clicks pass through, like the shooter's drawing layer and its score readout. Everything else falls as before.

**What I checked, with the shooter on:**
- After pressing G, 39 pieces fell, none ended up above the screen, and 38 piled in the bottom half.
- I fired at the fallen pile and blew up 10 words.
- Pressing G again put the page back, and R brought the words back.
- No errors came up, and a screenshot shows the pile at the bottom with the ship in front.
